notes.title: Quality of Life Update!
notes.content:
[p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33322639/24469b978a53d7769eeb5ed5475afe34775e6695.gif"][/img]Patch Notes:[/p][olist][*][p]The top left of the HUD now has an instant night button[/p][/*][*][p]Holding left click with the sword out, will now create a continuous whirlwind.[/p][/*][*][p]Player health per level increase to 50 from 10.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a settings menu for audio and video settings[/p][/*][*][p]Engine has been upgraded to Unity 6[/p][/*][/olist][p]Thanks,
Rat Wrath Team[/p]

notes.title: Quality of Life Update Coming Soon
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33322639/ff63ea1b95d83ac35b9146798ddc1597df86fbac.gif"][/img]Fortified Swiss is getting a much needed update![/p][p]The current plan is to upgrade the project to Unity 6 so it is easier to maintain.[/p][p]Add in the missing settings menu.[/p][p]As well as providing some balance updates and an instant night button.[/p][p]Thanks,[/p][p]Rat Wrath Team[/p]
